Name: Stardew Valley Comprehensive Tax
Author: OceanRambler
Description:
[b]写在前面。游戏时间不算太长，但也有近2年时间。星露谷可以让我们在繁忙而复杂的生活中增加一点点平静的祥和与安宁，暂时的回归到一个简单而丰富的世界。希望每个星露谷物语的玩家都能在游戏中获得自己独有的快乐体验。[/b]
[b]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]
MOD功能
游戏本身是积极的、正能量的，所以游戏中的一切都是正向增长的，为了追求更真实的体验和增加一定的游戏难度来平衡游戏性，因而设置了税收系统。季度税单的快捷键是F7，可自行修改。
1  土地税（可以理解为政府的行政管理费用）
按你实际占的地皮收，按格计算。所有耕地、果树、灌木、箱子、家具、机器、洒水器、铺的地板、建筑占地都算，同格不重复计费。如果通过其它mod（ 例如Stardew Realty ）购买农场，则整张地图的尺寸都会被计入。 选项中也能添加土地税的白名单与黑名单（用以排除某些特定的场景） 计费项目和单价在选项菜单中可调。
2  能源费（可以理解为水电费）
建筑按内部空间格数计算 + 每台生产机器（含洒水器）+ 每只动物（骑乘的马、宠物、还有饲养的史莱姆）。放在箱子里或背包里的机器不算，只认摆在农场里的。 计费项目和单价在选项菜单中可调。
3  所得税
按五档累进，收入主要分两类：第一类归为主营收入也就是通过出货箱卖出货品（这里说明一下本mod也支持集镇MOD，之前我有使用其它税收MOD都不支持集镇摆摊），这部分是默认全额计税的；另一类统称为其它类收入，也就是通过NPC买卖、战斗掉落、任务与信件来的收入），这部分由你自己决定是否申报。重要提示，不申报的这部分应税额，在下个季度有概率会被稽查，如果正好查到你，税务系统会对你进行罚金。罚金会比交税高得多。税率档位和比率、稽查概率，罚金倍数在选项中可调.
如果安装了GMCM，可在游戏中进行设置，否则需要在游戏外更改config文件.，建议没太清晰思路的情况下，采用默认设置即可有良好的游戏体验。
4  奖惩机制
先说奖励部分，如果及时且全额的提交了税费，有概率获得相应的纳税奖励。目前设置了2个奖励，一个是按比率返税，另一个则是来自镇长的奖励。
相应惩罚部分，逾期或者资金不足以支持超大农场规模的时候，惩罚会比较严重。设置了5天的缓冲期，可以有段时间来补足税额， 当然每天的欠费利息还是会持续计算，但是之后会对玩家农场的建筑和机器进行强制征收。
在欠费期间，NPC的好感度每天都会下降，同时也限制了玩家在木匠商店进行建筑的建设与升级。
不过以我自己的游戏经验来看，玩到破产也是很有难度的。

将StardewTax文件包解压到Mod文件夹即可

Mod包需要安装 SMAPI 4.3.0 or newer.同时建议安装GMCM，方便修改配置.支持 Market Town Mod 。支持自定义包、自定义NPC与邮件框架模组，理论上支持共享账户的多人模式（未实测）。

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ## What this mod does

The game itself is positive and upbeat — everything in it grows in one direction, upward. I wanted a more realty experience, and a little more difficulty to balance out that gameplay, so I built in a tax system. The quarterly tax sheet opens on **F7**, and the key is remappable.

1. Land tax (think of it as the government's administrative fee)

Charged per tile of land you actually occupy. Tilled soil, fruit trees, bushes, chests, furniture, machines, sprinklers, flooring you've laid down and building footprints all count; the same tile is never charged twice. If you buy a farm through another mod (Stardew Realty, for example), the whole map's size is counted. The options also take a whitelist and a blacklist to the specific scenario . Which items are charged, and at what price, can be changed in the options menu.

2. Energy fees (think of them as your water and power bill)

Charged per interior tile of a building, plus one unit per producing machine (sprinklers included), plus one per animal — riding horses, pets, and the slugs you keep. Machines stored in a chest or in your backpack don't count; only what's actually placed out on the farm does. Which items are charged, and at what price, can be changed in the options menu.

3. Income tax

Five progressive brackets. Income comes in two broad categories.

**Primary income** is what you sell through the shipping bin. This mod also compatible the **Market Town** mod （ I'd used other tax mods before and none of them counted market-stall income）and it is taxed in full by default.

**Other income** covers everything else: buying and selling with villagers, combat drops, and money from quests or letters. Whether you declare it is **your** call. One important note: undeclared taxable income may be audited the following quarter, and if you're the one they catch, the tax office issues a fine. That fine will be considerably higher than the tax would have been. The bracket thresholds and rates, the audit chance and the fine multiplier are all adjustable in the options.

If you have Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) installed you can set everything in-game; otherwise edit the config file outside the game. If you don't have a clear idea of what you want yet, the default settings already give a good experience.

4. Rewards and penalties

Rewards first: pay in full and on time and you may receive a taxpayer's reward. There are two of them right now — a percentage of your bill handed back, and another reward from the mayor Lewis.

Penalties: when you're overdue, or your funds can't support a farm that's outgrown them, they get serious. There's a five-day grace period in which you can make up the shortfall. Interest on the arrears keeps accruing every day during that time, and afterwards the tax office moves in and seizes buildings and machines on the farm.

While you owe money, friendship with every villager drops a little each day, and construction and upgrades at the carpenter's shop are refused.That said, going by my own playtime: reaching actual bankruptcy is genuinely hard to do.

## Installation

Unzip the `StardewTax` folder into your `Mods` folder.

Requires SMAPI 4.3.0 or newer. GMCM is recommended — it makes adjusting the settings much easier. Supports the Market Town mod. Supports content packs, custom NPCs and Mail Framework Mod. Multiplayer with a shared farm account should work in theory — I haven't tested it myself.
